messages:
maya: Kicking off phased bring-up for v4.1-int4 on chat + longdoc slices. Starting 5% shadow -> 1% live A/B for 30m windows. Gate on MRR_delta, hallucination_rate, p95 latency. Runbook: https://go/redwood/onboard/v4.1-int4 :rocket:
prashant: Quick smoke (shadow) summary: overall MRR -0.6%, longdoc slice -1.8%, p95 +15ms, halluc_rate +0.4pp. Not catastrophic but longdoc looks noisy.
elena: Starting 1% A/B now. Auto-fallback rules: if MRR_delta <= -1.0% OR hallucination_rate_delta >= 0.5pp OR error_rate +0.5pp then immediate rollback. Also soft-watch if p95 increases >20ms for >2 windows.
sam: Can you paste the rollout guard JSON so infra can wire the alerting? Want structured-output fidelity in checks too.
maya: Copied config below (excerpt):
```json
{"gates": {"mrr_delta_pct": -1.0, "halluc_rate_pp": 0.5, "p95_latency_ms": 20, "error_rate_pp": 0.5}, "window_mins": 30, "auto_fallback": true, "slices": ["chat", "longdoc"]}
```
eval-bot: 30m smoke results posted: control_vs_test = {"overall_mrr_delta":"-0.7%","longdoc_mrr_delta":"-1.9%","hallucination_rate_delta":"+0.45pp","p95_latency_ms":"+12"} (sampled N=4.2k).
prashant: @maya if longdoc stays ~-1.9% I'd hold. That crosses our soft limit and is close to auto-fallback. :thinking_face:
maya: Agreed — pausing promotion and widening sample to 5% shadow for one more hour. If halluc_rate crosses 0.5pp or longdoc MRR <= -2.0% we'll trigger the rollback hook and notify oncall. Adding a note to runbook.
elena: I'll run targeted prompt set evals for longdoc edge cases and post examples in thread. If we can identify prompt families causing degradation we can fix quant config or split routing.
maya: Thanks — keeping this thread as the single source of truth. Will update when shadow->promote or fallback happens. :eyes:
